SELECT DECODE(A.BIN,NULL,B.BIN,A.BIN) AS BIN, DECODE(A.BIN_NAME,NULL,'BIN' || B.BIN,A.BIN_NAME) AS BIN_NAME,CNT, DECODE(COLOR,NULL,'FFFFFF',SUBSTR(COLOR,2)) AS COLOR FROM ( SELECT * FROM TQP_BINDESC WHERE PROGRAM = :program ) A, ( SELECT BIN,COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM TD_?? WHERE WAFER_SEQ = :wafer_seq GROUP BY BIN ) B WHERE A.BIN(+) = B.BIN ORDER BY BIN
